fields.question: What is Fan Hub Plus?
fields.keyword: what is fan hub, about, platform, overview, features, what can i do
fields.answer: Fan Hub Plus is one place to explore Anime, Gaming, Movies, TV Shows, K-Pop, Comics, Manga and Cosplay. Browse articles, videos, trailers, character profiles, merchandise showcases, upcoming releases and fan events.

fields.question: How do I create an account?
fields.keyword: account, register, sign up, signup, create account, join
fields.answer: Click Register at the top right, fill in your details and verify your email using the link we send you. After that you can log in and use your dashboard, bookmarks and ratings.

fields.question: I forgot my password. What do I do?
fields.keyword: forgot password, reset password, password, cant log in, locked out
fields.answer: On the login page choose the forgot password link, enter your email and we will send you a reset link. The link expires after a while, so request a new one if it stops working.

fields.question: How do I search and filter content?
fields.keyword: search, find, filter, sort, explore, genre, release year, popular
fields.answer: Open Explore. You can search by title, filter by category, genre, release year and content type, and sort by latest, most popular or alphabetical.

fields.question: How do I bookmark something?
fields.keyword: bookmark, save, favorite, favourite, save for later, note
fields.answer: When you are logged in, use the bookmark button on any article, video, character profile or merchandise item. You can add a note, and everything you save appears on your dashboard.

fields.question: How do I rate a video or audio clip?
fields.keyword: rate, rating, stars, star, thumbs up, review, like
fields.answer: Open any video or audio item while logged in and use the rating control on the page. You can change your rating later.

fields.question: Can I submit my own fan content?
fields.keyword: submit, fan content, fan art, article, upload, contribute, post
fields.answer: Yes. Registered users can submit fan articles and content from the submit page. An admin reviews every submission before it is published.

fields.question: Where can I find events near me?
fields.keyword: event, events, convention, meetup, screening, near me, nearby, map, calendar, tickets
fields.answer: Open Events to see upcoming conventions, cosplay meetups and screenings. You can filter by city, use the map to find nearby events, and follow the ticket link on each event.

fields.question: Can I buy merchandise here?
fields.keyword: buy, purchase, merch, merchandise, shop, order, price, checkout, collectible
fields.answer: The merchandise section is a showcase only. You can browse items and see tags like Limited Edition or Pre-Order, but purchases and orders are not handled on this site.

fields.question: How do I change dark mode or text size?
fields.keyword: dark mode, light mode, theme, font size, text size, bigger text, accessibility, contrast
fields.answer: Use the theme toggle and the text size controls in the top navigation bar. Your choice is remembered on this device.

fields.question: How do I report a bug or send feedback?
fields.keyword: feedback, bug, report, problem, issue, suggestion, contact, help
fields.answer: Use the feedback form. Choose whether it is a bug, a suggestion or a question, write your message and send it. An admin will review it.
